blocks.text: Notepad aur Microsoft Word jaisi applications mein undo stack se banta hai. Aap jo bhi kaam (action) karte hain woh stack par save ho jata hai. Undo karne par sab se taaza action stack se nikal kar ulat diya jata hai. Is tarah aap pichhli state (halat) mein wapas aa jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “Not Pad” chhapa hai; sahi naam Notepad hai (Windows ka text editor).
Misal: sochiye aap text editor mein document mein kai tabdeeliyan karte hain, jaise naya text likhna ya purana mitana. Undo aise kaam karta hai:

items: Kaam karna: har tabdeeli (likhna ya mitana) stack par save hoti hai. Maslan aap ne “Hello” likha to yeh action stack par push ho gaya.
Undo karna: undo dabane par sab se taaza action (jaise “Hello” likhna) stack se nikalta hai, aur editor use ulat deta hai, yaani document se “Hello” mita deta hai.
Kai baar undo: baar baar undo dabane se pichhle actions ulte order mein ek ek kar ke ulatte jate hain. Agar “Hello” ke baad “World” likha tha, to undo pehle “World” hatayega, phir “Hello”.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
Restaurant ki kitchen mein plates ke dher (stack) ko sambhalne ka kaam sochiye. Python code likhein jo plates rakhne aur uthane ka kaam dikhaye.
Requirements (kya karna hai):
1. Stack class banayein:
• list se plates ka stack dikhane wali Stack class banayein.
• push (plate rakhna), pop (plate uthana) aur peek (top plate dekhna, nikale baghair) methods banayein.
2. Stack operations dikhayein:
• Plate 1, Plate 2, Plate 3 push karein.
• Har plate ke baad stack dikhayein.
• Ek plate pop karein, aur nikali hui plate aur stack dono print karein.
• Top plate peek kar ke print karein.

blocks.caption: Class Activity ka ek mumkin hal (kitab mein hal nahi diya; yeh hamara code hai)

blocks.text:
Stack: ['Plate 1']
Stack: ['Plate 1', 'Plate 2']
Stack: ['Plate 1', 'Plate 2', 'Plate 3']
Removed: Plate 3 Stack: ['Plate 1', 'Plate 2']
Top plate: Plate 2
blocks.caption: Output (Python 3.13 mein chala kar)

blocks.prompt: Class activity ke code mein aakhir mein peek kya dikhata hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Plate 2. Plate 3 sab se oopar thi aur pop ho gayi; ab Plate 2 top par hai, aur peek use nikale baghair dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Do asal zindagi ki misalein bataiye jahan stack istemal hota hai, aur in mein stack ke operations kaise chalte hain (long question 3).
blocks.explanation: Text editor ka undo: har tabdeeli push hoti hai; undo sab se taaza tabdeeli pop kar ke ulat deta hai, is liye tabdeeliyan nayi se purani ke order mein wapas hoti hain. Browser ka Back button: har khola hua page push hota hai; Back abhi wala (current) page pop kar ke us se neeche wala page dikhata hai. Plates ka dher bhi aisa hi hai: nayi plate oopar aati hai aur oopar wali pehle uthti hai.

items: Undo: har action push, undo sab se taaza action pop kar ke ulat deta hai.
Stack class ko push, pop aur peek chahiyein.
